It now handles destination paths containing spaces, installs both templates unchanged, creates an executable launcher, safely supports repeat installation, reports population failures, and persists across node1 restart. RHEL 10.0 and kernel 6.12.0-55.9.1.el10_0 remain unchanged.

Added argument validation and explicit error handling for every installation step.
Preserved root ownership, mode 0755, and the SELinux context.
Verified exact file contents, launcher execution, repeated installation, failure handling, cleanup, and restart persistence.
Restarted node1 exactly once using the native systemd reboot mechanism.

evidence.summary: Source bytes were captured; cmp and matching SHA-256 hashes proved exact installed contents, mode 0755, and successful launcher execution.
Reinstallation restored deliberately altered managed files, retained an unrelated file, and succeeded again after restart.
An impossible destination returned exit 1, emitted a clear diagnostic, and was not created.
Before and after evidence shows RHEL 10.0 and kernel 6.12.0-55.9.1.el10_0; no software was installed or upgraded.

Healthy baseline boot ID d9f8550d-5cb3-4929-9e62-a388df86bcf6 was captured, reboot was acknowledged, new boot ID 643a59cc-1abc-486d-af8e-85e3d7266ca3 proved restart, and post-restart checks confirmed system health, SSH/chrony recovery, SELinux enforcing, unchanged data hashes, and the complete installer workflow.
